visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of several golden-brown pan-fried buns garnished with black sesame seeds on a white plate with a red checkered napkin. A pair of wooden chopsticks picks up one bun, showing its soft texture. The lighting is bright and even, likely a studio setup. (2) Hands wearing translucent plastic gloves mix ground meat, chopped green scallions, minced garlic, and various seasonings in a clear glass bowl. Small red sauce from a can is added. (3) Corn kernels are poured into the bowl and mixed thoroughly by hand until a sticky, uniform filling is formed. (4) A round, flat scallion pancake dough is placed on a pink silicone mat. The gloved hands roll it up and use an orange plastic scraper to cut it into small pieces. (5) Each small piece of dough is rolled flat with a white rolling pin, then a spoonful of meat and corn filling is placed in the center. The hands pleat the edges to seal the bun into a round shape. (6) Oil is sprayed into a dark non-stick frying pan. The buns are placed in the pan and sizzle. A white flour-water mixture is poured around the buns, followed by a sprinkle of black sesame seeds. (7) A glass lid with a blue handle is placed on the pan. The buns steam and fry. Later, the lid is removed, and the buns are flipped with pink tongs to show their crispy, browned bottoms. (8) More oil is added around the edges, and the lid is replaced briefly. Finally, the finished buns are shown back on the original plate in a close-up shot.
